$Comment: Seasons of Orbis, the top rung of the ladder: the keepsake of every season this server runs, and
MetaSelector writes no Needs, so it asks for every season it finds: each season whose yearly
keepsake carries the season_keepsake tag, any year's copy standing for it. AtLeast is the floor
under that count, the second rung's Needs, so it comes after the second rung and waits until a
server runs a fourth season. A new season raises the count, and a player who already earned this
keeps it. A season a server owner switches off in calendar.json leaves the count, so this stays
within reach while at least four seasons are on. The description's number comes from TextArgs, so
Rewards: the title Seasons_Of_Orbis_Every_Season (the Title reward kind) lands the moment it is
earned, the one thing an achievement pays on unlock. The game's Harvest Trophy, the festival tokens
and the Festival Favor are Claims, waiting on the achievements page until the player collects them,
so a full bag never costs anyone the trophy.
Keep this file's name: it is the id every player's progress on it is filed under. Filed under
Seasons with no subcategory, which is where the Almanac looks for its banner.
